text: Custodial exchanges are largely unprepared for breach: only 53 percent of small custodial exchanges and 78 percent of large custodial exchanges have a written policy setting out what happens to customer funds if a security breach causes loss.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
abstract: Just 53% of small custodial exchanges and 78% of large custodial exchanges have a written policy outlining what happens to customer funds in the event of a security breach resulting in the loss of customer funds.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: custodial cryptocurrency exchanges surveyed in the 2017 benchmarking study
